market_regime_audit.source_rule: equal-weight arithmetic mean of other four completed closes; common complete 54-bar days; strict prior date; no fill

entry_fill: completed 5m bar signal -> next tradable bar open

holding_counter_semantics.timeout_counter: observed 5-minute bars since entry; overnight/non-trading time does not increment the counter
holding_counter_semantics.day_equivalence: max_hold_bars / 54 is a complete-session equivalent; intraday entry and next-bar-open exit mean it is not guaranteed to exit exactly at the Nth session close
holding_counter_semantics.cross_day_measure: number of observed trading-date transitions between actual entry-open and exit-open; inclusive session count is transitions + 1

exit_priority: inherited engine: stop/time risk exits are checked before technical exit; queued exit executes at next tradable open; end-of-backtest mark is separately labelled
